entities.summary: Ryan Clark Holiday is an American marketer and author. He became known for writing books and marketing them with non-traditional methods. He has now also become known for marketing Stoicism as a lifestyle and philosophy for modern people. Specifically, the philosophy advocated by Roman emperor Marcus Aurelius.
